contract: Resident supplied attention-output tail 64x64 via 256 hidden features on 8x8 PEs. Typed half output projection, residual, RMSNorm, block-f32 up/gate/down, SiLU/multiply and final postprojection Z add. Shared forward two-hop DSR engine, CSL RMS/accumulator libraries and joined completion. Immutable public inputs; no intermediate host transfer. Eight SDK calls; independent actual native/device projection, delta and final accuracy; exact staged half/f32 observations, mutation checks, ELF memory and three matched adapted-source calls. Not full Prefill/Decode or hardware performance.
